notes.title: Renovation Simulator Status Update
notes.content:
Hello renovators! I hope you’re all doing well.  

I need to do a quick update on the status of the game. Unfortunately, I’ve been down for the past couple of weeks with an illness in the family, myself being under the weather as well. It seemed like everything was pulling me away from the game. It’s been frustrating and I’ve been chomping at the bit to get back working full time on it. Thankfully things have settled down and I’m back full time on the game. 

The career mode is coming along nicely. Most of what we are working on is infrastructure for the new mode and the game. Things like: email system, messaging, new UI, jobs, the new vertex painting system, debris, new house models (I’m very excited about this), various new assets, paint color customization, a hardware store…And many more little things. The maps will come last in the order of things.

We’ve added a new development branch for testing the development build of the game. You are free to try this branch but keep in mind that the game will be: buggy, glitchy, potentially unstable, not save game compatible, not feature complete and will not represent the actual current state of the game. 

The beta branch is used for release candidate testing and you’re free to try that if you feel like it.

We’ve also added a youtube channel (not much there ATM). We’ll be adding some let’s plays as well as possibly some ‘watch the dev’ type stuff. Our channel is at: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6aXK0obrhgp6prEA9SCkwg

We also desperately need to update the store page. We’ll try and do that in march.

Stay warm and keep your brushes clean!
Thanks from Argon Gaming!

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.6.6 Patch Notes

The career mode is coming along nicely. We should have an update and screenshots in 2-3 weeks. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.6.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Update to the placement system.

As we are working on the Career mode, some of these updates will make it into the game along the way before the release of the Career mode. Today we have an update that, when placing any item that is placed on a wall, will snap to the wall. You will no longer have to rotate the item to get it flush with the wall surface. This makes adding wall items much easier, including kitchen cabinets. Eventually we will have item snapping so that items like kitchen cabinets will snap to each other for easier placement.

Updates:
-Update to the placement system to have items correctly snap to the surface of a wall.
-Added running sounds to the refridgerators.
-Added click and hold for picking up an item or applying a texture to surface.
-Added click and hold for returning an itme to the inventory.

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue where the player could spawn an unlimited number of equipment items.

Thank you from Argon Gaming!

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.6.2, Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Renovators, we have a big update for both display and graphics settings that will allow you to tweak performance and visual quality to a much greater degree.

Updates for Display settings:
-Added NVIDIA DLSS features: NIS, Frame Generation, Dynamic Vibrance, Ray Reconstruction and DLSS Sharpness for supported RTX cards.
-Updated AMD FSR.
-Added XeSS support for anyone who has an Intel graphics card.
-Added NVIDIA Reflex support.
-Added gamma settings.
-Added color blindness settings. For anyone who may have color blindness, this will allow you to tweak the settings to a fine degree to match your needs. Includes support for: Deuteranope, Protanope, Tritanope and a severity setting.
-Added Field Of View setting.
-Updated Frame Rate Limit to a slider instead of a switcher and increased the max value to 580.

Updates for Graphics settings:
-Moved FSR and DLSS settings to Display settings.
-Moved Antialiasing Type to Display settings.
-Removed Dynamic Resolution as it's not properly supported on desktop systems yet.
-Moved Anti-Aliasing quality to Graphics settings.
-Updated Motion Blur.
-Added Bloom.
-Added Lens Flair.
-Added Sharpness.
-Added Amibent Occlusion.
-Added Global Illumination Quality switcher.
-Added Reflection Method switcher.
-Added Lumen quality settings.
-Added Reflection Quality settings.
-Added option for Hardware Ray Tracing.
-Added quality options for Hardware Ray Tracing.

General Updates:
-Changed default interaction key to 'E' from 'F'.
-Changed default flashlight key to 'F' from 'L'.
-Added a settings detail panel for graphics and display settings. Most settings will have a description and metrics on how it affects your system. Just click on a setting to get it's details in the panel.
-Changed layout of Settings to support the settings details panel on the right for graphics and display pages.
-Turn the time to 9PM (2100 hours) for a surprise! Event goes from 9-10PM every night until January 10th . Happy New Year!

Fixes:
-Escape (Pause Menu, default), Tab (Game Menu, default) and Q (Inventory, default) will now open and close their respective menues without haveing to click the 'Continue' or 'Close' buttons. Unless of course you really, really want to.

------------

Important: We highly reccomend people reset their display, graphics and audio settings. They won't reflect the correct settings initially. This will ensure the settings displayed are correct. You can then update them to your liking. This only needs to be done once.

------------

We are currently working on the much anticipated Career Mode and expect an early version out by late February or early March.

Happy holidays to all and which ever holidays you may celebrate, have a safe and fun holiday season. 
As always, if you have any questions, comments, thoughts or requests please let us know in the discussion forums on Steam or on our discord; https://discord.gg/M9bt6avmjC

Thank you from Argon Gaming!

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.6.0, Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Renovators, we have a snowy Merry Christmas update for all of you. Details below.

Updates:

-Added Christmas furniture.

-Added Christmas toys.
-Added Christmas trees.
-Added a new main menu for the holidays.

Notes:
Decorations, when placed on a door will not attach to the door, so they won't move with the door. This is a current limitation that will be addressed in a future update after the holidays.
Many products can have their presets (colors, materials, light colors) changed with the left and right arrow keys (default). Any description that has "With Presets" has this ability.
You can also press the 'R' key to randomize the colors, materials and light colors on those products.
The following products will toggle randomly changing their light color when pressing the 'R' key:
Garland w/lights, Merry and bright sign, Tree lamp, Single color short and long light strands, Wreaths with lights.
The fireplace can be toggled on and off with the interaction key ('F" default).


Happy holidays to all and which ever holidays you may celebrate, have a safe and fun holiday season.

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Gardening Update
notes.content:
Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.5.6, Patch Notes

Gardening Update. We beat Spring to the punch. Suck it Spring! Trees, bushes and flowers oh my! There's a bunch of new gardening items to use, plus updated firepits to keep you warm during the winter months. 

Updates:
-Added trees.
-Added bushes.
-Added Flowers.
-Added various plants.
-Added flower beds.
-Added new decorations.
-All trees, bushes, flowers, plants, rocks and flower beds in each of the creative maps are now movable and removable.
-Updated firepits in Patio with fire and sound effects.
-Updated environmental sounds to use audio occlusion. Sounds outside a house won't sound as loud inside the house.
-Added option to highlight moveable items in 'Quick Settings'.
-Added ability to lock an item to prevent it from being moved, removed or returned to inventory. The item can still be interacted with if the item is interactable (turn on, off, etc.). Key binding is under 'Interaction'. Default is 'b' key.
-Removed 'Continue' button from main menu. Players will need to select the map they wish to continue in the creative page.
-Improved headlamp light.
-Reduced rotation speed and decreased degrees per second an item rotates to allow for greater precision.

Fixes:
-All options in 'Quick Settings' now save when changed.
-Added missing toolbar key bindings in settings.
-Fixed potential duplication issue when returning an item to the inventory.
-Updated delete item confirmation popup to use the new CommonUI popup.

There's still a ton of new items to add, but we're a small team so we thank you for your patience! The next major update will be the career mode. We're expecting to have a basic version of it out some time in February. We'll continue to add new items and features and refinements for your gaming fun during it's development. As always, if you have any questions, thoughts or requests please let us know in the discussion forums or on discord (https://discord.gg/M9bt6avmjC). The road map is in the discussion forums and on discord for your reading pleasure.

Thank you from Argon Gaming!

notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.4.6, Patch Notes

-The UI has gotten an big overhaul. Much of the update is foundational, but visually it's now consistent as well as several fixes to the settings menus. The controls page now allows players to have up to two bindings per input action (keyboard, mouse and gamepad). This enables full gamepad support for the game. The inventory has been moved into the game menu below 'Products' and still uses the 'q' key for quick access.
-Two doorways were updated that were blocking players from passing through.
-Fixed FSR sharpness slider.

As always, if you have any questions, thoughts or requests please let us know in the discussion forums or on discord (https://discord.gg/M9bt6avmjC). The road map is in the discussion forums and on discord for your reading pleasure.

Thank you from Argon Gaming!

Known issues: 
Skylites have been removed for the time being as rain and snow will fall through them if it's raining or snowing. This is a known issue and we will try and resolve this in a future update.
If Fog is dense enough it will be seen inside a house. This is a known issue and we will try and resolve this in a future update.
There are sloped ceiling sections that will not paint. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.

notes.title: House and Halloween update

notes.title: Renovation Simulator Version 0.4.2.1, Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060982/fc4f9b2dc74eb3ee52a568fea5c202066e1dfe69.png

Welcome to the Rise and Shine update! It's a dark and stormy night, or a sunny day, or a snow day, or night or any time. Pick your time of day and weather to help set the mood. Patch details below:

Note: It's highly recomended to reset all of the saves for any creative maps that you are working on. If not, it can result in odd behavior.

•	Players can now change time of day and have the time change in real time. Saved per map.
•	Players can now change the weather with presets per map. Saved per map.
•	Players can select random weather that changes every 15-30 minutes. Saved per map.
•	Added musical instruments.
    •	Various accessories.
    •	Acoustic and electric guitars.
    •	Keyboards.
    •	Violins and double bass'.
    •	Saxaphones.
    •	Pianos
    •	Drum kits
•	Added new chairs.
•	Separated out the chairs category into sub-categories.
•	Added new tables.
    •	Coffee tables.
    •	Side Tables.
•	Separated out the tables category into sub-categories.
•	Added new sofas.
    •	Sectional.
    •	Standard.
•	Separated out the sofas category into sub-categories.
•	Added new rugs.
•	Updates to the creative maps to support the weather update.
•	Patio lights (except for any with a movement sensor) will turn on at 8pm and off at 7am.
•	Added environmental sounds.
    •	Birds will start in the morning and stop at dusk.
    •	Crickets will start at dusk and stop at dawn.
    •	Birds and crickets will stop on certain inclement weathers.
•	Added a 5th creative map to have fun in. It's a big one with lots of space inside and out.
•	Removed shutters from the 4th creative house. After some discussion, we realized they didn't fit the look of the house.
•	Some athletic equipment resized as they were a bit too big.
•	Updated some paintings and wall items that were'nt alighning with walls quite right.
•	Updated the standing/hanging kitchen cabinets to be easier to place. Will add snapping in a future patch.
•	Removed some items from the tool bar as they were not necessary.
•	Updated the static meshes for some tools.
•	Added FSR as an upscaling option in video settings.
•	Added Anti-Aliasing options including Anti-Aliasing quality setting.
•	Fixed window glass that had a really high refraction index that made it look odd at high angles.
•	Various small tweaks and fixes.
 
Current known issues: 
Unfortunately we've had to remove the skylites for the time being as rain and sknow will fall through them if it's raining or snowing. This is a known issue and we will try and resolve this in the future.
If Fog is dense enough it will be seen inside a house. This is a known issue and we will try and resolve this in the future.
A few wall pieces will color both sides when painted. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.
Trim on walls when painted will paint all trim. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.
Two lights are non-interactive when they should be interactive. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.
There are sloped ceiling sections that will not paint. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.
Wall trim will paint both sides of a wall. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future update.
Lumen has some issues with shadows (Lumen crawl). This is a known issue with Unreal Engine currently.

notes.title: Rise and Shine Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060982/fc4f9b2dc74eb3ee52a568fea5c202066e1dfe69.png

Our first big update introduces the new weather system! It's a dark and stormy night, or a sunny day, or a snow day, or night. Pick your time of day and weather to help set the mood. You can now change time of day and change real time time of day, set the weather with presets or select weather that changes randomly every 15-30 minutes. 

With many new assets added as well including a big new creative map to have fun in.
